hooks.command: IN=$(cat); SID=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); MARKER="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/instruction-audit-pending-$SID"; [ -n "$SID" ] && [ -f "$MARKER" ] && { rm -f "$MARKER"; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"Stop","additionalContext":"A SKILL.md or CLAUDE.md file was edited this turn. Once every change to it is done, run instruction-audit on it."}}'; }; true

IN=$(cat); SID=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); [ -n "$SID" ] && printf '%s' "$IN" | grep -qE '"file_path":"[^"]*(SKILL\.md|CLAUDE\.md)"' && touch "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/instruction-audit-pending-$SID"; true
